summary: MPLS LSP Ping and Traceroute use a Reply Mode field to say how the echo reply should travel. This standards-track RFC changes the procedure for the Reply via Specified Path mode, value 5, giving a simpler way to say which return path to use. It updates RFC 7110.

eli5.summary: When you ask someone to write back, you can say which road the answer should take. This makes it simpler to name that road.
